subject: 🐋 Your notes are right where you left them
preview: Three small steps, if you'd like to pick things back up.
h1_light: It's been a couple of weeks.
h1_bold: Everything is right where you left it.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: This isn't a guilt trip, promise. Life gets busy, and therapy has its own rhythm. If you have a session coming up, MindSync can help you get ready for it in a few minutes.
Coming back takes about five minutes

items: Open your Therapy Agenda and see what's still on it.
Do one short Reflect about the last two weeks.
Bring your Before therapy card to your next session.

blocks.alt: Three MindSync screens: the Before therapy card with numbered questions, the After therapy card with the progress chart, and Timeline

buttons.label: NOT NOW, PAUSE EMAILS FOR 30 DAYS

blocks.text: Did something in MindSync not work for you? Hit reply and tell me. That's how we find out what to fix.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.
